_doc: The template forge init copies for a new user: every third-party tool forge depends on and the Python libraries its scripts import. Copy it to config/toolchain.json and edit: `tools` are mise tool names (node, python, npm:<package>, pipx:<package>, http:<name> with an `options.url`, or a plain mise tool), `pip` are libraries scripts import under plain python3, `skills` are online skills (an entry names an `http:` tool of `tools`, with a checksum option, and a path in its archive: forge skills copies the path into skills/<name> byte for byte and generates its NOTICE.md). `version` is an exact pin, `track` is latest (forge update follows upstream) or frozen, and `why` says what needs the entry. forge toolchain --fix writes ~/.config/mise/conf.d/forge.toml and ~/.default-python-packages from it and installs what is missing; mise keeps each tool in a directory that holds no node or python version, so an upgrade of either never removes one.

tools.name: node
tools.why: the runtime of every npm: tool and of the Node hooks

tools.name: python
tools.why: the runtime of forge and of its scripts

tools.name: npm:pnpm
tools.why: the package manager of the Node projects
